Is this you?

Covering your mouth when you laugh. Hiding in group photos.

Often it isn’t one big problem. It’s a few small things together — a chip, some staining, a gap, a tooth out of line — that add up to a smile you would rather not show.

Stained or discoloured teeth

Coffee, tea and time. Whitening toothpaste stopped making a difference years ago.

Chipped, worn or uneven edges

Small things on their own, but together they make a smile look older and less even than you feel.

More than one thing you’d change

Saving photos of smiles you love, but not sure what is realistic for your own teeth.

Your options

A smile makeover isn’t automatically veneers

Depending on what you would like to change, it could be one treatment or a carefully planned combination. Your consultation tells you which — and why.

Professional whitening

Lifts staining and brightens your natural teeth, for a fresher smile without changing their shape.

Clear aligners

Straightens crooked or crowded teeth and closes gaps, discreetly. Pristine Aligners start from £699.

Composite bonding

Tooth-coloured material shaped by hand to repair chips, close small gaps and even out edges.

Veneers

Thin, custom-made covers for the front of your teeth, to change their shape and colour where it is needed.

Find out what suits me

Which treatments suit you, and what they cost, is explained in full at your consultation, before you commit to anything.

What you get

What happens at your consultation

  • A conversation first — what you like, and what makes you self-conscious
  • An examination of your teeth and gums

Questions

The things patients ask us first

No. Depending on your teeth, it could be whitening, clear aligners, composite bonding, veneers, or a planned combination. Your consultation explains which options suit you.

It shouldn’t. A natural result is planned around your face, your existing teeth and the look you are comfortable with. Bring photos of smiles you like — and ones you don’t.

It depends on which treatments your plan includes, which is why the cost is worked out at your consultation and explained in full before you commit to anything. Clear aligners start from £699.

It depends on the treatments involved. Whitening and bonding are usually quicker; aligners take longer. Your plan sets out the timeline before you start.

It’s a conversation first. You tell us what bothers you, the team examines your teeth and explains your options, and you leave with clear information. Nothing is booked on the day unless you want it to be.

Things come up — we simply ask for at least 24 hours’ notice so the slot can go to someone who needs it. Missed appointments or late cancellations may carry a fee for longer, high-demand slots.
